retrievalProfile.description: A solarized, high-contrast band portrait with infrared-style foliage and decorative swash typography in the upper right quadrant.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of four men in 1960s attire, processed with a solarized or infrared effect that turns foliage into pale, ghostly textures against a deep reddish-brown background, featuring prominent decorative typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject figures arranged in a staggered, multi-depth composition
High-contrast solarization effect creating metallic highlights on skin and clothing
Typography anchored to the top right corner, balancing the weight of the foreground figures
Desaturated, cool-toned subjects against a warm, saturated background
coreInvariants: Deep reddish-brown or burgundy background color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects at varying scales; one large figure in the bottom left foreground, three smaller figures receding into the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large foreground figure in the bottom left and the bright yellow typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large foreground face, moves diagonally up to the right toward the typography, then circles back through the smaller band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense foliage textures fill the upper left and center, providing a busy but low-contrast backdrop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep burgundy/reddish-brown background and foliage shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale blue and white solarized highlights on clothing and skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the glowing, solarized subjects; high saturation in the background vs desaturated subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy use of decorative swashes on ascenders and descenders
High stroke contrast with thick verticals and thin horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended 'G' and 'R' with tails that underline or cradle adjacent letters
Tightly kerned and overlapping 'ss' and 'oo' pairs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, ornate swash serif paired with a smaller, cleaner serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular logo block in bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1960s decorative serif aesthetic with heavy swashes.
Provides the high-contrast, slightly weathered vintage feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four men in 1960s fashion, applying a solarized infrared effect where foliage is pale and skin/clothing has metallic blue-white highlights against a deep burgundy background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, golden-yellow decorative swash-serif text in the top right corner, ensuring letters interlock and overlap slightly.

verificationChecks: Is the solarization effect present on the subjects?
Does the typography feature prominent decorative swashes?
Is the background a deep reddish-brown tone?
Are the subjects arranged in a multi-depth staggered composition?

postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen on skin highlights
Ensure foliage appears ghostly and pale
Confirm color palette is limited to burgundy, yellow, and pale blue
recipe.reuseFormula: Solarized Portrait + Infrared Foliage + Swash Serif Typography
